intro: Runs each complaint from start to finish: takes the details, opens a numbered ticket, creates a PDF report and sends it on WhatsApp to the caller and the authority, then follows up and escalates until it is resolved.
Part of Spectrum’s [AI Contact Center](service:ai-contact-center): take the whole seven-part system, or only the parts you need. Every part shares one customer record.

items.title: The caller gets through
items.text: By phone or WhatsApp. The menu asks who they are and what the problem is.

items.title: The AI listens
items.text: It writes down what is said and works out whether it is a question or a complaint.

items.title: A ticket and report
items.text: For a complaint, a ticket opens (for example TKT-20261109-0001) and a PDF report goes on WhatsApp to the caller and the authority.

items.title: Follow-up until solved
items.text: Timed reminders and escalation continue until the case is closed and the caller is told.
